Introduction

KIIRAS is a six-member global girl group under LeanBranding. They made their debut with the mini album "KILL MA BO$$" on June 9, 2025.

The group was first announced on April 18, 2025, and, on April 24, it was confirmed that they will have six members, which were then revealed daily from April 29 to May 4, starting with Harin, followed by Kurumi, Kylie, Doyeon, Roah, and lastly, former I-LAND2: N/a contestant Lingling, which had already previously been announced on April 18, 2025. It was also reported that singer-songwriter SAAY will be heavily involved in the group's production and vocal training.
